opportunities.title: Your Trailer's Brakes Are on Bluetooth and Anyone Can Slam Them On
opportunities.why_now: Researchers just disclosed that Elecbrakes' Bluetooth trailer braking systems can be remotely hijacked by anyone with a phone, turning a convenience feature into a roadside weapon.
opportunities.angle: Explainer on the vuln chain + 'inevitable breach' framing: when IoT convenience features ship without auth, physical safety becomes a CVE

opportunities.title: ShinyHunters Never Left: Meet 'Inception,' the Extortion Crew With 7 Victims in 7 Days
opportunities.why_now: A new group possibly rebranding from ShinyHunters has already claimed seven corporate victims in a single week, a pace worth tracking as a live breach counter.
opportunities.angle: Threat actor profile + running victim tally, positioned as 'who's next' tracker

opportunities.title: From Zero-Day to Root in 11 Minutes: AI Agents Just Changed the Patch Clock
opportunities.why_now: Dark Reading reports AI agents can go from flaw discovery to full root access in 11 minutes, collapsing the window defenders have to patch before exploitation.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence math piece: compare your org's mean-time-to-patch against an 11-minute AI attacker, with a call to action on virtual patching

opportunities.title: One Azure API Flaw, Three Nations' Power Grids: Inside the Norway Energy Firm Breach
opportunities.why_now: Norway just confirmed a critical Azure API Management vulnerability was used to steal secrets from its energy sector, with Microsoft patching only after exploitation was already underway.
opportunities.angle: Critical infra breach deep-dive tying together Register, SecurityWeek, Hacker News, and Bleeping Computer reporting into one timeline of exploit-before-patch

opportunities.title: Cisco's Critical RCE Is Already Under Attack — Here's Your Patch-or-Perish Window
opportunities.why_now: A critical Cisco remote code execution bug is being actively exploited right now, making this a live patch-cadence emergency for network admins.
opportunities.angle: Rapid-response CVE bulletin format: what's vulnerable, what attackers are doing, and the clock on patching before wider exploitation
